slides.question: Can India's second team win it?

concept: Two teams at opposite ends of the same final, so the hero sets them side by side: Pakistan's 'first SAFF final ever' in muted grey and India's 'going for title No. 10' in white, with 9 titles against a 1st final in the fact row. Slide 2 is the warning sign in one big number, the 3-2 group game where Pakistan nearly erased a 3-0 lead in stoppage time. Slide 3 explains the twist that makes tonight interesting: India's seniors are in New Zealand, so a reserve side is defending the title, and it asks fans if they can finish the job. Football green, type and pitch graphics only: no player photos, no federation logos.
caption:
Pakistan have never played in a SAFF final. India have won nine.

Tonight in Dhaka they meet in the 2026 SAFF Championship final. India are the defending champions and are going for title number 10.

The twist: India's senior team is on tour in New Zealand, so coach Naushad Moosa has brought a reserve side. It beat Bhutan 2-1 in the semi-final.

Pakistan knocked out hosts Bangladesh 1-0 with a goal five minutes from time.

The warning sign is the group game on Nov 5. India led 3-0 after 31 minutes and Pakistan scored twice in stoppage time to make it 3-2.

Can India's second team win the title? Tell us below.
